correctness.rationale: For \(k\not\equiv2\pmod5\), the Tjurina ideal equals \((x^2+2y^{13},xy^{12}+2k y^{k-1},y^{\min(k,25)})\); for \(k\equiv2\pmod5\), it equals \((x^2+2y^{13},xy^{12}-y^{k-1},y^{\min(25,2k-14)})\). In both cases the local standard basis has leading monomials \(x^2,xy^{12},y^r\), giving length \(r+12\). The proof establishes finite length for every stated exponent.

value.rationale: Tjurina number is a natural deformation invariant of an isolated hypersurface singularity. The exact all-exponent profile explains how a published characteristic-five jump continues and identifies the precise stabilization at \(37\), contrasting with the linear characteristic-zero profile. This is a motivated family invariant, not a routine relabeling or a claim about modality beyond established results.
